raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the payments source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records (15 rows, each with orig_txn_id) and no longer updates the original, which stays POSTED. silver_transactions keeps only POSTED rows, so reversed originals are still counted and gold totals run high, while no monitor checks for this. Excluding POSTED originals that a REVERSAL record references matches the existing REVERSED-status convention, but this assumes full (not partial) reversals and that settlement nets on the original transaction date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) NOT IN (SELECT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL);"}}
